query: Is there multi-source agreement that cardiac rehab improves outcomes after MI?

pubmed.title: RCT: cardiac rehab improves VO2 after MI
pubmed.summary: Randomized controlled trial found cardiac rehabilitation improved VO2 max after myocardial infarction compared with usual care.

cochrane.title: Cochrane review: cardiac rehab after MI
cochrane.summary: Systematic review demonstrated cardiac rehabilitation reduces rehospitalisation after myocardial infarction.

openalex.title: Observational confirmation of rehab benefit post-MI
openalex.summary: Observational data showed cardiac rehabilitation participation associated with lower rehospitalisation after myocardial infarction.

semantic_scholar.title: Meta-analysis of exercise-based rehab post-MI
semantic_scholar.summary: Meta-analysis found exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation improved functional outcomes after myocardial infarction.
